CustomField.description: Ticked by automation when something that affects the holder's automatic stop codes changes (a license, relationship, bond, exam, application, fee, payment or hours). A background job then re-checks the stop codes and unticks it, once per holder per save. Not for manual edit. If it stays ticked, the background job failed: see the flow error email, then untick and tick it again to retry.
CustomField.label: Stop Code Sync Pending
